risks.risk: Speakers could be damaged or distorted

Photo of the power adapter included with the unit
Close-up photo of the LCD screen while powered on

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha PSR-175 keyboard from the visible branding and model text, but the seller's 'working perfectly' claim is unverifiable from a static photo alone, so it must be priced at worst case (functionality unproven) until a power-on/sound video is provided.
